business_summary: Marriott is an asset-light worldwide franchisor, operator and licensor of hotels and lodging brands. Revenue is mostly franchise, management and incentive fees tied to hotel revenues and profits, plus owned/leased revenue and large pass-through cost reimbursements.

pack_proposed.reason: SIC 7011 and the business is lodging franchising and management, with fees driven by RevPAR, occupancy and ADR.
pack_proposed.quote: We are a worldwide franchisor, operator, and licensor of hotel, residential, timeshare, and other lodging properties under a portfolio of compelling brands at different price and service points.

drivers.reason: Higher interest rates make financing harder for hotel owners and slow new development and pipeline conversion.
drivers.quote: making it more difficult for hotel owners to obtain financing on commercially acceptable terms, or at all

edges.reason: Fees are percentages of hotel revenues, which rise with RevPAR and demand.
edges.quote: The increase in base management fees primarily reflected higher RevPAR as well as rooms growth ($25 million).

edges.reason: ADR growth drove RevPAR growth, lifting fee revenues.
edges.quote: In 2025, worldwide RevPAR increased 2.0 percent compared to 2024, driven by ADR growth of 2.1 percent.

edges.reason: Rooms growth adds franchise and management fees.
edges.quote: In 2026, we expect net rooms growth of 4.5 to 5.0 percent.

edges.reason: Incentive fees are based on hotel profits, so demand lifts margins.
edges.quote: The increase in incentive management fees primarily reflected higher profits at managed hotels.

operating_kpis_suggested.name: Worldwide systemwide RevPAR growth
operating_kpis_suggested.definition: Revenue per available room for comparable systemwide properties, year over year, constant dollar
operating_kpis_suggested.quote: In 2025, worldwide RevPAR increased 2.0 percent compared to 2024, driven by ADR growth of 2.1 percent.

operating_kpis_suggested.name: Net rooms growth
operating_kpis_suggested.definition: Year-over-year growth in total rooms in system
operating_kpis_suggested.quote: In 2026, we expect net rooms growth of 4.5 to 5.0 percent.

operating_kpis_suggested.name: Development pipeline rooms
operating_kpis_suggested.definition: Rooms in the development pipeline, including under construction
operating_kpis_suggested.quote: At year-end 2025, we had approximately 4,100 properties and nearly 610,000 rooms in our development pipeline

item.name: gross_margin_owned_leased_proxy_g_and_a_pct
item.description: General and administrative expense as a percent of revenue
item.reason: Overhead leverage on an asset-light fee model affects operating margin.
item.quote: General and administrative expenses decreased primarily due to lower compensation costs ($39 million).
